title: Fix the AI section test's guard noticing a player behind it under load
body:
`templates/3d-third-person/game/tests/gameplay/test_ai_section.gd` failed at line 100 in two separate local full-suite runs on 2026-11-12: a guard noticed the player standing behind it. Seen on the #1306 and #1262 branches, both after main at 70473979. Each time it passed alone three times, and on #1306 also three times after the same preceding suites. The machine was heavily loaded both times (about 15 Godot runs at once).

A guard's perception should never see behind it, whatever the frame timing. A timing-dependent pass means the perception check depends on how many physics ticks run, or on a stale facing, before the test reads it.

Done when:
- The cause is found: the guard's facing or the view cone read on a tick where the guard is still turning, a perception tick count that depends on frame time, or a test that reads too early.
- The test is deterministic: it passes under a fixed clock and under a slowed or loaded clock (for example `Engine.time_scale` or skipped frames), and fails first on the cause.
- If the guard really can notice behind it under load, that's fixed in the perception code, not the test.
